Class DinosaurManager

java.lang.Object
DinosaurManager
public class DinosaurManager extends Object
Edgar Lopez CEN 3024C - Software Development 1 November 16, 2026 DinosaurManager.java Manages the dinosaur collection and provides operations for validating, adding, finding, updating, removing, and searching dinosaur records. This class supports the overall program objective of organizing and managing dinosaur information
